name: Form
description: A lightweight form wrapper that collects field values on submit and shares an error map through context, with no form library.
usage:
<Form
  errors={{ email: 'Use your work email' }}
  onSubmit={(values) => console.log(values)}
>
  <Field label="Work email" required>
    <Input name="email" type="email" />
  </Field>
  <Button type="submit" variant="primary">Save</Button>
</Form>

anatomy.description: A semantic form that prevents the default navigation and collects named values with FormData on submit.
The errors map shared with descendants, read through useFormFieldError without prop drilling.
Named inputs whose values arrive in the onSubmit payload; repeated names become arrays.
Submit and reset buttons supplied by the caller.

dos: Give every collected control a name attribute; unnamed controls are skipped.
Render server errors next to their fields, and add a FormErrorSummary for long forms.
Put the submit Button inside the Form so Enter submission works.
donts: Don't reach for it when you need async per-field validation or dependent fields; adopt a form library.
Don't duplicate the errors map into local state; pass it straight to the errors prop.

examples.title: Submitting values
examples.description: onSubmit receives every named field value collected with FormData; the default page navigation is prevented.

examples.title: Server error map
examples.description: The errors prop is exposed through context so descendants can render per-field messages without prop drilling.

guidance.useWhen: A plain HTML form needs value collection and a shared validation error map without adopting a form library.
guidance.avoidWhen: Complex per-field state, async validation, or dependent fields are required; a dedicated form library fits better.
guidance.behavior: Submitting collects values with FormData (repeated names become arrays) and calls onSubmit after preventing navigation; the errors map is read through useFormFieldError.
guidance.responsive: Layout is fully caller-controlled; stack fields single-column on narrow screens.

notes: Renders a semantic form element; give it an accessible name when the page has several forms.
Error messages flow through context so fields can link them with aria-describedby and mark controls aria-invalid.
